name: Light Sand Entire Primed Wall
intent: Full-wall fine sand of cured primer to flatten any nibs, lap lines, or dust inclusions before finish coats. Only required at QT4 and QT5; lower tiers rely on spot sanding from the inspect/repair module. Always followed by a vacuum dust pass before paint goes on.
doctrine: QT5 sands more slowly because grit is finer (220+) and the inspector is checking for surface flatness, not just defect removal. QT4 uses 180-220 grit and is faster. Skipping this module on QT4/QT5 leaves visible texture under low-angle light. Vacuum is mandatory before paint — leaving sanding dust on the wall causes adhesion failure and visible inclusions.
